component.name: Crow
component.summary: Manage Linux servers over plain SSH

description.p: Crow is a native desktop app for people who run Linux servers. It's agentless: it talks to your servers over plain SSH, reusing one connection per server, and never installs anything on them.

ul.li: A fleet view of every server's health, alerts and containers
Services, logs, users, firewall, packages, certificates and config files
Terminals that use the same connection and keys as everything else
An encrypted vault for keys and secrets, unlocked by your OS keyring
Cloud providers, Dokku apps and plugins of your own
A record of every connection Crow makes, and a switch to stop them all

description.p: Crow is in active development: features move between releases and the vault format can change.
